title: Not landing that first externship? here's the real deets (format C, night desk)

brief.problem: Students apply to one or two postings, hear nothing, and don't know what to change; postings differ in hours, certifications and dates.
hooks: not landing that first externship? here's the real deets
applying to externships and hearing nothing back?
still trying to land your first externship?
things nobody tells you about applying for externships
brief.why: Growth Ops brief concept 1; a broad struggle hook that works outside Ontario (pain point 1: silence and rejection, P019/P038/P050). Slides deliver 'the real deets': silence is common, apply wider, read every line (with one verified Ontario example), track dates. Rejected: 'nobody tells you' overclaims; the question-only hook is weaker than the promise of specifics.
brief.payoff: Four practical moves (expect silence, apply wider, read every line, track dates) plus a verified example of how postings differ.

slides.title: not landing that first externship? here's the real deets
hearing nothing back is common
slides.body: extern spots can be competitive, and lots of students apply. silence isn't a verdict on you.

slides.label: extern notes 📝
slides.title: apply to more than one
slides.body: apply wherever you actually qualify, and keep a list of where you applied and when each one closes.

slides.title: read every line
slides.body: Women’s College’s posting: up to 7.5 hours a week, BCLS required. these details differ by hospital.

slides.title: track every closing date
slides.body: some postings list a closing date and some don't. note each one the day you find it.

slides.title: looking for extern postings in ontario?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca lists them with closing dates and listed requirements, checked on each hospital's own careers page.

caption.text:
not landing that first externship? here’s the real deets 👇

hearing nothing back is common. apply wherever you qualify, read every line of each posting, and note each closing date the day you find it. one Ontario example of why reading closely matters: Women’s College’s extern posting lists up to 7.5 hours a week and asks for BCLS.

what’s been the hardest part for you?

ontarioexterns.ca is an independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
